# Load the data
```{r}
path <- "../data" 

files <- list.files(path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

data_list <- list()

for (file in files) {
  data <- read.csv(file)
  data_list[[file]] <- data
}

```

```{r}

```


```{r}
par_1 <- read.csv("../data/0188_experiment_data.csv")
par_2 <- read.csv("../data/0189_experiment_data.csv")
par_3 <- read.csv("../data/0190_experiment_data.csv")
par_4 <- read.csv("../data/0191_experiment_data.csv")
par_5 <- read.csv("../data/0192_experiment_data.csv")
par_6 <- read.csv("../data/0193_experiment_data.csv")
par_7 <- read.csv("../data/0194_experiment_data.csv")
par_8 <- read.csv("../data/0195_experiment_data.csv")


par_5$subject <- as.character(par_5$subject)
par_6$subject <- as.character(par_6$subject)
par_7$subject <- as.character(par_7$subject)
par_8$subject <- as.character(par_8$subject)

merged <- bind_rows(par_1, par_2, par_3, par_4, par_5, par_6, par_7, par_8)
```

```{r}

# Double the target duration
merged$target_duration_ms <- merged$target_duration_ms * 2

# Double the mask duration
merged$mask_duration_ms <- merged$mask_duration_ms * 2

# Double the fixation duration
merged$fixation_duration_ms <- merged$fixation_duration_ms * 2

```

```{r}

# Dropping the last empty column

merged = subset(merged, select = -c(X))

```

```{r}

library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Aggregate data
agg_data <- merged %>%
  group_by(subjective_response) %>%
  summarise(avg_reaction_time = mean(objective_response_time_ms), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(agg_data, aes(x = subjective_response, y = avg_reaction_time)) +
  xlab("PAS score") +
  ylab("Reaction Time") +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  ggtitle("Reaction time between subjects across PAS scores")+
  theme_minimal()

```
